item.title: Designing for a Longer Material Life
item.description: Design a household desk lamp that can be serviced, rebuilt or taken apart for its materials. Discuss what happens from sourcing the metal to retiring the lamp.

children.definition: An approach that makes a product easy to take apart without damaging the components that need to be kept.
children.example: The team applied design for disassembly by using clips that let a technician remove the lamp's shade without bending it.

children.definition: A self-contained unit that can take the place of another unit in the same position using the existing connections.
children.example: The lamp's LED unit is an interchangeable module that uses the same connector and mounting points across three models.

children.definition: A record of the materials and substances that make up a product or component.
children.example: The lamp's composition record identifies the alloy in the base and the coating on the shade, both of which the processor needs to know before sorting the parts.

children.definition: An input for production obtained by processing discarded products or manufacturing scrap.
children.example: The foundry proposed aluminium from discarded window frames as a secondary material for casting the lamp's base.

children.definition: A system that recovers used material and feeds it back into production of the same kind of item.
children.example: In the closed-loop recycling system, crates that can no longer be repaired are shredded and moulded into new crates.
children.translation_ru: система переработки с возвратом материалов в производство однотипных изделий
children.translation_uz: qayta ishlangan materiallarni shu turdagi buyumlar ishlab chiqarishda qayta qoʻllash tizimi
collocations: set up a closed-loop recycling system

children.definition: The environmental effects associated with a product’s materials and the processes used to make and supply it, within the life-cycle stages covered by the assessment.
children.example: To estimate the lamp's embodied impact, the team requested figures for metal production, factory assembly and delivery.
children.translation_ru: воздействие на окружающую среду, связанное с материалами, производством и поставкой изделия
children.translation_uz: buyumning materiallari, ishlab chiqarilishi va yetkazib berilishi bilan bogʻliq ekologik taʼsir

children.definition: An environmental effect arising from activities earlier in the supply chain than the operation being studied.
children.example: From the lamp assembler's perspective, the effect of water withdrawals at the alloy supplier's plant counts as an upstream impact.
children.translation_ru: воздействие на окружающую среду на предшествующих этапах цепочки поставок
children.translation_uz: taʼminot zanjirining oldingi bosqichlaridagi ekologik taʼsir

children.definition: The ease with which a product can be inspected, maintained or repaired, including how easily a fault can be found.
children.example: To test the lamp's serviceability, the team timed how long a technician took to locate a loose connection and restore power.
children.translation_uz: texnik xizmat koʻrsatish va taʼmirlash qulayligi

children.definition: The point at which a product reaches the end of its service life and is taken out of use.
children.example: At end of life, a lamp with a cracked base goes to a processor who separates the metals from the electronics.

children.definition: To rebuild a used product through a controlled industrial process and test it against the performance requirements for a new unit.
children.example: The factory can remanufacture returned lamps by inspecting the housings, fitting new wiring where needed and testing each finished unit to the same standard as a new lamp.
children.translation_ru: восстанавливать изделие в заводских условиях до характеристик нового
children.translation_uz: buyumni zavod sharoitida yangi buyum talablariga mos holda tiklamoq

children.definition: The extraction and preparation of usable substances from discarded goods for use as inputs in production.
children.example: The processor's estimate for feedstock reclamation included separating the aluminium from the steel inserts and preparing the aluminium for melting.
children.translation_uz: ikkilamchi xomashyoni ajratib olish va tayyorlash

children.definition: The extent to which an arrangement keeps products, components and substances in use through continued use, rebuilding or processing for further production.
children.example: To gauge circularity across the lamp range, the team tracked which returned units went back into use and which yielded metal for further production.
children.translation_ru: степень сохранения изделий, деталей и материалов в хозяйственном обороте
children.translation_uz: buyumlar, qismlar va materiallarning qay darajada foydalanishda saqlanishi

children.definition: A flow of substances grouped by type as they move through collection, sorting or processing.
children.example: The processor sends the lamp's steel inserts into a separate material stream from its aluminium base.

children.definition: The deliberate limitation of how long a product can remain usable or useful, intended to bring forward the purchase of a replacement.
children.example: The project brief ruled out planned obsolescence, including a proposal to disable the lamp after a fixed number of operating hours to prompt a new purchase.
children.translation_uz: buyumning foydali xizmat muddatini ataylab qisqartirish
